question_text: I am yellow and long and monkeys love to eat me. What am I?
I say moo and I give you milk. What am I?
I am round and I am in the sky and I am very hot. What am I?
I have four legs and I say meow. What am I?
I am white and you drink me every day. What am I?
I am red and round and you put me in a salad. What am I?
I have a long trunk and two big ears. What am I?
You wear me on your feet when you go outside. What am I?
I have wings and I sing in the morning. What am I?
I am cold and white and I melt in your hand. What am I?
I am white inside and hens lay me. What am I?
I am green and I grow on the ground and cows eat me. What am I?
I am orange and rabbits love to eat me. What am I?
I have many pages and you read me. What am I?
I have two wheels and you ride me. What am I?
I am dark at night and I am full of stars. What am I?
I am soft and you rest your head on me. What am I?
I am sweet and cold and I melt very fast. What am I?
I carry my house on my back and I move very slowly. What am I?
You switch me on and I give you light. What am I?
I am tall and green and I give you shade. What am I?
I have a tail and I bark and I am your best friend. What am I?
I am round and you kick me and I bounce. What am I?
I come in the sky after the rain and I have many colours. What am I?
I have petals and I smell very sweet. What am I?
I take you to school and I have many seats. What am I?
I am white and fluffy and I float in the sky. What am I?
I live in the sea and I have a hard shell and I walk sideways. What am I?
I am tiny and black and I live with many friends in a line. What am I?
I am full of water and you sit in me to get clean. What am I?
I have no legs at all but I can swim all day. What am I?
I am full of water and boats float on top of me. What am I?
I go up and I come down but I never leave my place. What am I?
I am brown outside and white inside and I grow high on a tree. What am I?
I belong to you but your friends say me more than you do. What am I?
I follow you everywhere in the sunshine but I disappear at night. What am I?
I have a face and two hands and I tell you the time. What am I?
I am striped like a zebra on the outside but I am a sweet red fruit. What am I?
I have a neck but no head and I hold your drink. What am I?
I have very many legs and I live under stones in the garden. What am I?
I have leaves but I am not a tree and you turn me to read. What am I?
The more you take away from me the bigger I get. What am I?
I am full of holes but I can still hold water. What am I?
I run all day long but I never get tired and I never walk. What am I?
I am clean and dark and your teacher writes on me with chalk. What am I?
I have four legs but I cannot walk and you eat your food on me. What am I?
I open and I close all day and you walk right through me. What am I?
I am as light as a feather but nobody can hold me for very long. What am I?
I have many keys but I cannot open a single door. What am I?
I have a face that is bright at night and I change my shape every week. What am I?
I am made of wood and I have many steps and I help you reach high. What am I?
I have teeth but I cannot bite and I make your hair neat. What am I?
I have one eye but I cannot see and thread passes through me. What am I?
I go all the way around your house but I never come inside. What am I?
I am thin and wooden and you write with me and I get shorter every day. What am I?
The more you cut me the more I make you cry. What am I?
I ring when somebody wants to talk to you far away. What am I?
I fly without any wings and I cry without any eyes. What am I?
I get wet while I am drying you. What am I?
I have a head and a tail but I have no body at all. What am I?
I have cities but no houses and rivers but no water. What am I?
What has a face and two hands but no arms and no legs?
I am always coming tomorrow but I never actually arrive. What am I?
I am the only bird that can copy the way you talk. What am I?
I have branches but no fruit and no trunk and no leaves. What am I?
I only go up and I can never come down. What am I?
accepted_answers: age | my age | how old you are

question_text: I have a neck and a body but no arms and I hold your flowers. What am I?
I have many rings but I am not jewellery and you count me to know how old a tree is. What am I?
What goes up whenever the rain comes down?
I am so delicate that even saying my name will break me. What am I?
I can travel all around the world while staying in one corner. What am I?
I have a bank but no money and a bed but I never sleep. What am I?
I am tall when I am young and short when I am old. What am I?
What can you catch very easily but never ever throw?
I am a room that you can never walk into. What am I?
I am not alive but I grow and I have no lungs but I need air. What am I?
I have a neck but no head and two arms but no hands. What am I?
I live in the ocean but I am not a fish and I have five arms. What am I?
I can fill a whole room but I take up no space at all. What am I?
What can you break very easily without ever touching it?
I have a thumb and four fingers but I am not alive. What am I?
What comes down from the sky but never goes back up?
What kind of coat can only be put on when it is wet?
I am an odd number. Take away one letter from my name and I become even. What am I?
I have keys and a screen and you press me to write on a computer. What am I?
I follow you all day but you can never step on my head. What am I?
The person who makes me does not need me and the person who buys me does not use me. What am I?
I am black when you buy me and red when you use me and grey when you throw me away. What am I?
What has one head and one foot and four legs?
I am found in every home and I turn round and round to keep you cool. What am I?
